name: 8-Bit
about: A theme that is always there to pick on the Theme page (see launcher_theme.py and README.txt in this folder): the launcher as an 8 / 16-bit console menu. Its buttons are the pictures in the 8bit-ui folder (art-src\scripts\bit_buttons.py draws them, with the sprites in art-src\8bit-sprites); its lettering is Galmuri11 (fonts folder, SIL Open Font License).
